_comment: SEEDED CATALOG. This file is the single source the storefront reads. At the API-connection stage, scripts/build-catalog.mjs overwrites it in CI by fetching Shopify products tagged 'barbermatic'. Shape here == shape the build produces. 'variantId' is empty until Shopify is connected; empty variantId => Add to Bag is disabled with a 'coming soon' note. Editorial copy for non-Amboyna pieces is placeholder to be replaced by Shopify metafields.

products.title: Ironwood Shaving Brush
products.description: A one-of-one shaving brush turned from dense, richly grained ironwood. Weighty in the hand with a warm, close grain and a comfortable, sculpted form. Fitted with a premium 24mm finest badger knot.

traits.title: ONE OF ONE
traits.body: This exact piece will not be repeated.

traits.title: MADE BY HAND
traits.body: Shaped, finished and assembled in Ireland.

traits.title: BUILT TO ENDURE
traits.body: Made to be used, made to last.

traits.title: NATURAL MATERIALS
traits.body: Grain, colour and character unique to this piece.

accordions.title: DETAILS
accordions.body: Overall height approx. 105mm. Handle turned from ironwood, finished to a deep gloss. The piece shown is the piece you will receive.

accordions.title: KNOT & PERFORMANCE
accordions.body: 24mm finest badger knot, hand-set. Soft tips with good backbone and water retention for both face and bowl lathering.

accordions.title: MATERIAL & PROVENANCE
accordions.body: Ironwood is among the densest and most durable of timbers. Natural variation in grain and colour is unique to this piece.

accordions.title: SHIPPING & RETURNS
accordions.body: Dispatched from County Cork within 2–3 working days. Tracked worldwide shipping. Returns accepted within 14 days in original condition.

accordions.title: CARE GUIDE
accordions.body: Rinse thoroughly after use, shake out excess water and hang or stand to dry away from direct heat. Avoid soaking the handle.
